notes.title: Nightfall Conquest: Demo Coming on September 15th!
notes.content:
Hey Conquerors!

We’ve got some awesome news that we’re super excited to share with you. The Nightfall Conquest demo is dropping on September 15th! 🥳

Whether you're a lone wolf or love teaming up with friends, there’s something for everyone in this demo. Here’s what you can look forward to:

What’s Inside:
✨ Single Player Adventure: Ready to dive into a world full of mystery and danger? Explore the first chapter of our story, face off against some tough enemies, and start unraveling the secrets of Nightfall.

👥 Multiplayer Map: Got some friends who love a good challenge? Team up and jump into demo multiplayer map. Whether you’re strategizing or just having a blast, you’ll need to work together to take down the big bad bosses and swarms of enemies.
